answer: Locks are written down in ferrous, expire in hollow, and willow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 111 aliases thus needs 153 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 53 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
